strict_research_hurdle.boundary: Research admission test only; never a guarantee, forecast, annual floor, allocation, holding or action authorization.

supportable_conclusions: C7 fixed multi-asset ETF market-price diagnostic has five of twelve complete calendar years and 1,428 of 1,952 rolling five-year endpoints below 5%; it is not total-return or execution evidence.
C8 fixed convertible-bond ETF price proxy has 2022 and 2023 below 5% and 123 of 187 rolling five-year endpoints below 5%; it is not investor net-return or execution evidence.
C10 fixed four-name direct-equity gross-cash diagnostic is -0.15% in 2022 and 2.05% in 2025; it is not a point-in-time full-universe total-return-and-execution result.
C11 fixed manager-published cumulative-NAV proxy for 008856 is below 5% in 2022, 2024 and 2025 and at all 204 available rolling 1260-observation endpoints; it is not a holder dealing result.

C14 fixed 508000 public-REIT zero-cost cash diagnostic is below 5% in 2023, 2024 and 2025 and at all 40 available rolling five-year endpoints; it is neither a personal net-after-cost result nor a public-REIT-universe conclusion.

C9 commodity actual-contract trend, C12 Treasury cash-futures basis and C13 ETF covered-call routes have documented mechanics but lack the point-in-time data and operational package needed to calculate strict net-return endpoints or establish personal operability.
Direct equities and public REITs remain open asset classes; the failure or unavailability of a bounded representative route is not an economic exclusion of its class.
No captured evidence supports a usable strategy, allocation, holding list or return expectation. The current conclusion is restricted to the bounded routes listed in R11.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not promote public market price, gross cash distributions, distribution yield or manager cumulative NAV into personal net total return.
Do not promote exchange rules, product documents or sparse actual-contract samples into a historical replay, fill model or individual account permission.
Do not use continuous futures as actual-contract/roll P&L or treat an ETF as a Treasury-futures deliverable bond.
Do not combine invalidated diagnostics with untestable derivatives routes into a usable multi-asset strategy.
Do not generalize one representative product to an entire asset class, or infer admission from a missing dossier.
next_research_sequence: For any reopened route, acquire documented-rights point-in-time total-return or actual-contract, event, cost/tax, quote/depth, fill and account-route data before freezing a protocol.
For an open-universe study, freeze the complete U0 population, admission rule, distribution treatment, execution/halts/partial-fill and cost rules before observing a result.
Independently recompute every complete-calendar-year and rolling-five-year endpoint and complete prospective paper reconciliation; a sub-5% endpoint or missing material field keeps q=0.
Changing the hard annual hurdle into a long-term objective requires a separately authorized research mandate, risk budget and acceptance test; it cannot be silently relaxed.
no_action_boundary: No subscription, redemption, purchase, sale, futures transaction, option transaction, repo, delivery, account opening, allocation or external action is authorized.
